mutants.description: The fault-log timestamp is restarted each time the host finishes reading the fault record (fault_reg_read_done), taking the timestamp to be time since the last episode, though it must free-run from rst_n
mutants.reason: Once the host has read through FTIME_2 (0x20), the TIME_0..2 registers read near zero instead of the time since reset. Every later fault_time snapshot is also measured from that read, not from start-up.

mutants.description: reg_file is held in reset while the debounced enable switch is off, as if switching off were a full reset of the host configuration
mutants.reason: Host writes to thresholds, CONTROL or SCRATCH are lost while the switch is off. Turning the switch off after configuring puts trip_run, trip_ss, max_strikes, max_on_limit and the rest back to their package defaults, and clears a host disable veto (spi_enable back to 1).

mutants.description: The supervisor's over-temperature input ORs the undebounced synchronised OTP flag with the debounced one ('trip at once, debounce only the release'), so the 1 ms assert qualification no longer applies to the FSM
mutants.reason: An OTP_trig glitch of only a few clocks pulls En low combinationally and sends the FSM to S_OFF, so the converter restarts through soft start. The design rides through glitches shorter than 1 ms.

mutants.description: soft_start's ramp runs through the hiccup cool-down as well as S_SS, as if cool-down plus retry were one ramp period, so the ceiling keeps widening while the gate driver is off
mutants.reason: The modulator keeps switching during S_HICCUP, so the ceiling (and SS_done) climbs during the cool-down. The retry then starts above MIN_ON_COUNTS, or the FSM leaves S_SS for S_RUN at once, and PWM_out pulses are wide right after re-enable instead of re-ramping from the floor.
